rules.firstAid: Existing health supply restores one accepted hit; no passive regeneration.

box.variants: Both original closed/open variants; no authored animation clips.
box.reward: Random existing weapon excluding current, full magazine plus four reserve magazines; owner-only pickup.
box.expiry: Unclaimed reward expires without refund. Owner death releases the box.

controls: RB / R1 on pad; CASSA on phone. Explicit proximity interaction, same floor and line of sight.

logic: Confirmed monster kill pays exactly 50 once, including duplicate damage callbacks
949 rejected; 950 accepted only nearby/on same floor; repeated presses and simultaneous contender never double-charge
Original ten-weapon pool, owned pickup, full magazine, no second debit, cooldown and return to idle
Expired unclaimed weapon is lost without granting or refunding
Every enemy strength takes exactly three accepted impacts to kill; same-contact grace, no duplicate death
Existing first aid restores exactly one hit, keeping hit count and health consistent
Owner death releases box safely; no posthumous weapon award
Host input edge triggers purchase; public box packet is a copy, not authority
Bot buys and retrieves through the same host input/cost/distance state machine
browser: Actual five-view Orda, original GLB closed/open, RB purchase at 950, no debit at 949, owned random weapon pickup
Real phone CASSA button traverses socket input to host authority and debits its own wallet
Actual kill adds 50; HUD/host three-hit rule, contact grace and elimination
tests.visual: Original open box and floating reward inspected in actual Orda renderer.

scope: Existing waves, last-survivor win condition and other games preserved. No fresh performance benchmark requested or claimed.
limits: Pad verification used mapped mock gamepad input; no physical gamepad session.
